description: t_edit then t_normalize (against the edited document): a normalized document + one edit → the normalized result, its problems, or an error code (README, Timeline rules: edits)

cases.description: move a V1 clip to another index: V1 ripples
move drops the dissolve of a cut it changes (c now follows a)
move keeps a dissolve whose cut did not change (b → c)
move an audio clip to a new start (snapped to a frame)
move an audio clip onto another audio track
trim the out edge shorter: V1 ripples
trim the out edge past the take's end: clamped to it
trim the in edge before 0: clamped to 0
trim the in edge of a clip with a 12-frame dissolve: its in stays at least 6 frames (the handle)
trim the out edge of the clip before a dissolve: its out leaves 6 frames of handle
trim the clip before a dissolve shorter than the dissolve's half: it keeps 6 frames
trim the in edge until the clip would vanish: one frame stays
trim an image's either edge changes its hold
trim an image below one frame: one frame stays
trim an audio clip's in edge: its start moves with it, the end stays
trim an audio clip's out edge
split a video clip at the playhead
split an image clip
split the clip with a dissolve: the right part has none
split at a cut
split past the end
split an audio clip
split a slot with a shot running
remove a V1 clip: V1 ripples, the next clip loses its dissolve
remove an audio clip
lift a V1 clip: an empty slot of its length stays
lift on an audio track
replace with another alternative: in kept, length kept within the take
replace with a take that is not an alternative
set gain, mute and a dissolve
set a dissolve longer than the handles
set removes a dissolve with null
add takes to V1 in order: video whole, image held 3 s
add a video take's sound to an audio track: at the track's end
add a silent take to an audio track
insert an empty slot at the cut nearest the playhead
insert at the end
fill a 1 s slot with a longer take: trimmed to the slot
fill a 6 s slot with a shorter take: the slot shrinks, V1 ripples
fill a slot with an image take
redo a clip (from this clip): the new take starts at 0, so the clip's dissolve, without a handle, goes
add an audio track; track gain and mute
track gain and mute
remove an audio track
V1 cannot be removed
add two sounds to an audio track: the second starts at the first frame after the first ends
split an audio clip at 29.97 fps: the left part ends on the right part's first sample
fill with a take shorter than the slot: a sound past the new end is cut there, one starting after it goes
take action, replace: a retake of the clip's own take keeps its in and out (the new part 0.375-1.375 is inside)
take action, replace: a retake of a clip off the 8-frame grid (in 0.5, out 1.5: frames 12-36 snap to pixels 9-32, 0.375-1.375) keeps the clip's in and out; nothing ripples
take action, replace: extend after grows the clip to the end of the extension; the next clip moves later
take action, replace: extend before (2 s) starts the clip at the new part and keeps its end, 2 s later in the new take
take action, insert after: the slot after the clip takes only the generated part
re-render of an extended clip: a new extension of the same source keeps the clip's in and ends at the new take's end
1.32: add an audio take to an audio track: whole, at the first frame after the track's end
1.32: an audio take added to V1 is wrong_track
1.32 Make shot, place inside an empty slot: the gap splits around the new slot (left keeps its id, the rest gets gap_id)
1.32 Make shot, place at an empty slot's start, longer than it: the slot replaces the gap and V1 ripples by the rest
1.32 Make shot, place inside a take's clip: the insert edit at the nearest cut
1.32 Make shot, place past V1's end: an empty slot up to it, then the new slot
1.32 New line: the take fills the placeholder whole at its start, joins its alternatives, the shot goes
1.32 New line: a take running into the next clip of the track is cut at that clip's start
1.32: trim a line placeholder: its hold changes, its start stays
1.32: replace an audio clip's take with another alternative: in kept, length kept within the take
1.32: trim an audio clip's out edge past its audio take's end: clamped to the take's end on the sample grid
1.32 New line: a take cut at the next clip of its track and past V1's end keeps the earlier cut (never lengthened back over that clip)
1.32 Make shot, place longer than its gap: an insert of the overflow, so an audio clip after the gap (m2, under b) moves on with V1; one before it (m) stays
1.50: roll the cut before b 6 frames later: a ends later, b starts later, the length and the dissolve stay, the linked v keeps its place
1.50: roll into an image: the video before ends later, the image holds less
1.50: roll that leaves the clip before under its least (half the dissolve): least
1.50: roll past the incoming take's start: normalize refuses it (trim)
1.50: roll the first clip: roll_first
1.50: roll on an audio track: roll_track
1.50: slip a 12 frames: in and out move, place and length stay
1.50: slip b: its linked sound v moves with b's content (12 frames later)
1.50: slip past the take's end: trim
1.50: slip over the dissolve's handle: dissolve_handles
1.50: slip an image: slip_still
1.50: slip an audio clip on the sample grid: at and length stay
1.50: slip an audio clip before its take's start: trim
1.50: slide the image c 12 frames later: b ends later, d starts later in its take
1.50: slide b: the linked v moves with it
1.50: slide the next clip past its take's start: trim
1.50: slide that leaves the clip before under its least: least
1.50: slide the first clip: slide_end
1.50: slide the last clip: slide_end
1.50: slide on an audio track: slide_track
1.50: overwrite d into a: a ends at 1 s, b loses its dissolve, d leaves an empty slot (the id given)
1.50: overwrite a over b's end and c's start: the slot it leaves takes b's dissolve away, c starts later in its hold
1.50: overwrite d inside c: c is cut in two (the right part first in ids), then the slot d leaves
1.50: overwrite past V1's end: the slot it leaves, then a gap up to it
1.50: overwrite with too few ids: ids_short
1.50: overwrite over a running shot: overwrite_shot
1.50: overwrite a V1 clip onto an audio track: overwrite_track
1.50: overwrite an audio clip into the middle of another: it is cut around it, the right part from the first frame after its end
1.50: overwrite an audio clip onto another track over the start of a clip there
1.50: overwrite an audio clip onto V1: overwrite_track
1.50: split_all at 4.75 s: c and n are cut, ids in track order
1.50: split_all inside b: b, m and the linked v are cut; v's right part links to b's right part
1.50: split_all on a V1 cut: only the clips across it (m) are cut
1.50: split_all past every clip: split_none
1.50: split_all with too few ids: ids_short
1.50: split_all skips a slot with a shot running
1.50: split b on V1: its linked v is cut there too, its right part (ids) linked to b's
1.50: split b with no id for its linked sound: ids_short
1.50: split b before its linked v: v links to the part it starts in
1.50: remove_range 1.5-2.5 s: every track cut at both ends and closed up (audio ripples); v relinks to b's right part
1.50: lift_range 1.5-2.5 s: V1 gets one empty slot, the audio a gap, nothing moves
1.50: remove_range past V1's end: only what is there goes
1.50: a range of no frames: range_empty
1.50: a range over a running shot: range_shot
1.50: a range with too few ids: ids_short
1.50: remove an audio clip with ripple: the later clips of its track move left by its length
1.50: remove b: its linked sound v goes with it
1.50: remove a: V1 ripples and b's linked v moves left with b
1.50: trim a shorter: b and its linked v move left 24 frames
1.50: move b first: its linked v moves with it
1.50: a linked clip pushed before 0: link_start
1.50: a linked clip pushed onto another clip of its track: overlap
1.50: set a link: m links to c
1.50: set a link to no V1 clip: link_not_v1
1.50: set a link on a V1 clip: link_track
1.50: set link null unlinks
1.50: add a marker: snapped to its frame
1.50: put a known marker again: replaced whole, the list sorted by time
1.50: remove a marker
1.50: remove an unknown marker: unknown_marker
1.50: a marker past the end: marker_past_end
1.50: removing the last clip leaves a marker past the end: marker_past_end
